body.name: Reciprocal endpoint normalization
body.construction: \(\mathcal C_\delta(b,q,\omega)=\{(y,z)\in\mathbb R_+^{|\mathcal S|}\times\mathbb R_+:\sum_sy_s=z;\ \sum_s\widetilde g_{tav}(s)y_s=b_{tav}z;\ \sum_s\mathbf 1\{h_t^0=v\}y_s=q_{tv}z;\ y_s=0\text{ if }h^0\neq h^1;\ \sum_{s,v}\omega_v\{r_{10v}(s)-r^{[0]}_{20v}(s)\}y_s=0;\ F_\delta y\leq0;\ \sum_{s,v}\omega_vr^{[0]}_{21v}(s)y_s=1\}\), where the two indexed equality families range over \(\mathcal T\times\mathcal A\times\mathcal V\) and \(\mathcal T\times\mathcal V_0\), respectively.
